purpose: DISCOVERY CANDIDATES ONLY. Not approved training data until verified + license-audited.

candidates.name: Aya Dataset
candidates.notes: 204k human prompt/completion pairs, 65 languages. Card: Apache-2.0, commercial OK.

candidates.name: Aya Collection
candidates.notes: ~513M instances, 115 languages, templated from 44 datasets incl. 19 translated sets. Separate human vs MT subsets.

candidates.name: Aya Collection (language split)
candidates.notes: Aya Collection partitioned per language; eases language-balanced sampling and low-resource quotas.

candidates.name: Aya Evaluation Suite
candidates.notes: Culturally grounded eval prompts. EVALUATION ONLY; must never enter train.jsonl.

candidates.name: Aya Red-teaming
candidates.notes: Harmful prompts, 8 languages, harm labels. Safety boundary data; hold out of training.

candidates.name: Belebele
candidates.notes: 122 variants/115 languages, 900 MC questions each. Card license cc-by-sa-4.0. Designed PRIMARILY as a test set; only a 'test' split exists.

candidates.name: Global-MMLU
candidates.notes: 42 languages; card separates professional vs machine translation and cultural annotations. Test split is benchmark.

candidates.name: MMMLU
candidates.notes: Multilingual MMLU translations. Benchmark; translation provenance must be recorded.

candidates.name: MMLU multilingual (alexandrainst)
candidates.notes: MT MMLU for Nordic+ languages; used to map translation-derived cross-dataset duplicates.

candidates.name: tiny-aya l2 thinker multilingual reasoning
candidates.notes: Multilingual reasoning traces (~44 langs). High WSTU interest; license/intended use must be read from card, not assumed.
